name: Cisco Firepower — Web C2 Beacon (entity-mapped v2)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_firepower_raw
| filter xdm.target.port in (80, 443) and xdm.source.ipv4 != null and xdm.target.ipv4 != null
| alter u_nomail = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.source.user.username, "^([^@]+)"), 0)
| alter bare_user = arrayindex(regextract(u_nomail, "([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)$"), 0)
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count() as callbacks by xdm.source.ipv4, xdm.target.ipv4, xdm.target.port,
       bare_user, xdm.source.host.hostname, xdm.network.application_protocol, _time
| filter callbacks >= 8
| alter c2_ip = xdm.target.ipv4, c2_port = xdm.target.port, beacon_user = bare_user,
        src_host = xdm.source.host.hostname, app_proto = xdm.network.application_protocol
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, c2_ip, c2_port, beacon_user, src_host, app_proto, callbacks
description: Recurring HTTP/S callbacks from one client to one external address (>=8 in 15m), Firepower. The XSIAM Firepower parser maps no domain field and keeps no raw log, so this keys on the destination address; the C2 address still groups it with the DNS and proxy beacon alerts.
alert_name: Cisco Firepower — Web C2 Beacon (entity-mapped v2)

TA0011 - Command and Control: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
